"One fish, two fish, red fish, blue fish." No matter the color, fish have delectable collars.

Whenever I see fish collar(s) on the menu, I pounce. This prized cut, which is still often undervalued, is a textural study. Depending on where you poke and prod between bones, you might find fluffy white meat, luscious dark meat or crispy, caramelized skin. Fish collars aren’t always available and are often in limited supply. After all, fish have just two collars. Whole fish or fortuitous specials are your only hopes. Find my favorite Los Angeles fish collars worth seeking since 2022.
